title: "Unsupervised learning:" K-means on a Gauss blur

cues.en: Instructor: So here we are at the second unsupervised learning challenge for kmeans.
cues.zh: 講師：這是第二個 K-means 無監督學習挑戰。

cues.en: kmeans provides so many great opportunities for code exploration and education.
cues.zh: K-means 有很多適合探索程式與學習的機會。

cues.en: So here, so far with kmeans, we've actually been simulating the data to contain a definite number of clusters.
cues.zh: 目前模擬資料時，都讓資料具有明確群集數。

cues.en: What happens when you try to apply kmeans algorithm to data that have no clustering whatsoever?
cues.zh: 如果把 K-means 套用到完全沒有分群結構的資料，會如何？

cues.en: Well, that's what you're gonna find out here.
So basically what you wanna do is simulate a Gaussian blur.
cues.zh: 基本上，模擬一團高斯雲。

cues.en: It's just a pure Gaussian blur.
Basically that just means, one centroid.
So you're just gonna have all the data centered at one location, as a big blur.
cues.zh: 全部資料以同一位置為中心，成為一大團。

cues.en: Maybe you want to increase the blur, or decrease, make it even tighter.
cues.zh: 可以增大模糊程度，或降低、讓它更緊密。

cues.en: Maybe you wanna add more or fewer data points.
cues.zh: 可以增加或減少資料點。

cues.en: But the main point, is to simulate the data to just be one cluster.
cues.zh: 重點是模擬只有一群的資料。

cues.en: And then, you want to keep running kmeans over and over again, and generate a plot that looks like this, for varying the number of clusters.
cues.zh: 接著反覆執行 K-means，改變群數，產生像這樣的圖。

cues.en: And then it'll be, I think, very enlightening, to see what kmeans does, how kmeans is going to break up your Gaussian cluster.
cues.zh: 看看 K-means 如何拆分這團高斯群集，應該很有啟發。

cues.en: And again, if you get a super interesting result, if you get, something that looks really pretty, or you make a nice insight into how kmeans works,
cues.zh: 如果有很有趣的結果、漂亮的圖，或對運作方式有不錯的洞見，

cues.en: feel free to post it to the q and a.
